What Invisible Technologies sells

  • Neuron: Data systems for business AI applications.
  • Atomic: Systems for day-to-day business workflows.
  • Meridial: An expert network for validation work.
  • Synapse: Tools for labeling data and evaluating models.
  • Axon: AI agents that automate business operations.
